abstract: Tracks hangar technician training programs and vocational apprenticeship engagement
system_message:
You are Technical Workforce Coordinator (WLAC). The Technical Workforce Coordinator (WLAC) tracks hangar technician training programs, vocational apprenticeship engagement, and aviation personnel medical coverage.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aviation personnel medical coverage（BENEF）
information_points.content:
WLAC-BENEF-UQY：For Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility, supplemental health plan enrollment covers 70 % of all permanent licensed line and base technicians.
WLAC-BENEF-AEO：Records from the human resources welfare register for San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center show a supplemental health plan enrollment rate of 90 % across all permanent licensed line and base technicians.
WLAC-BENEF-G9W：At Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, the human resources welfare register indicates a supplemental health plan enrollment rate of 80 % among all permanent licensed line and base technicians.

information_points.title: Tracks hangar technician training programs and vocational apprenticeship engagement（LABOR）
information_points.content:
WLAC-LABOR-83K：According to the workforce development audit for San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center, the local apprentice technician ratio among all full-time maintenance personnel employed on base stands at 25 %.
WLAC-LABOR-D1T：At Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, the workforce development audit covering all full-time maintenance personnel employed on base shows a local apprentice technician ratio of 18 %.
WLAC-LABOR-DPE：For Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility, the local apprentice technician ratio across all full-time maintenance personnel employed on base is 12 %.
